sources.title: [2112.03857] Grounded Language-Image Pre-training - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: This paper presents a grounded language-image pre-training (GLIP) model for learning object-level, language-aware, and semantic-rich visual representations. GLIP unifies object detection and phrase grounding for pre-training. sources.title: Preference-grounded Token-level Guidance for Language Model Fine-tuning
sources.snippet: In this paper, we address this issue by developing an alternate training process, where we iterate between grounding the sequence-level preference into token-level training guidance, and improving the LM with the learned guidance.

sources.title: Introducing the most grounded language model in the world - Contextual AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're introducing our Grounded Language Model (GLM), the most grounded language model in the world. With state-of-the-art performance on FACTS (the leading groundedness benchmark) and our customer datasets, the GLM is the single best language model for RAG and agentic use cases for which minimizing hallucinations is critical.
